study type: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: laboring for 2 hours or longer without cesarean delivery for nonreassuring FHR
preterm cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal heart rate
outcome: composite neonatal morbidity (Apgar score ≤3 at 5 minutes, seizure, sepsis, necrotizing enterocolitis grade II or III, intraventricular hemorrhage grade III or IV, or death before discharge)
cerebral palsy of any severity at 2 years or more of corrected age
moderate-to-severe cerebral palsy at 2 years or more of corrected age
cohort: 1291 preterm neonates born to women enrolled in a multicenter randomized trial of magnesium sulfate for the prevention of cerebral palsy
finding: Preterm neonates delivered by cesarean for nonreassuring fetal heart rate had a higher risk of cerebral palsy, particularly moderate-to-severe cerebral palsy, compared to those who did not.
mod_finding: Preterm neonates delivered by cesarean for nonreassuring fetal heart rate had a higher risk of cerebral palsy.
